$comment: DEMONSTRATION CASE LIBRARY — synthetic illustrative examples across disciplines. Not real events or citations. The UI labels these 'Demonstration record'.

cases.title: The Hedging Middle Power
cases.shortDescription: A mid-sized economy maintains security ties with one great power while deepening trade with its rival.
cases.longDescription: Illustrative case of strategic hedging: the state avoids formal alignment, diversifies arms suppliers, and uses multilateral forums to preserve autonomy.
researchQuestions: Under what conditions does hedging fail?

cases.title: Institutional Deadlock in a Multipolar Setting
cases.shortDescription: A multilateral body cannot agree on reform as the distribution of power shifts.

cases.title: Export Controls and the Semiconductor Supply Chain
cases.shortDescription: Advanced-economy export controls reshape a concentrated technology supply chain.

cases.title: Warehouse Automation and Local Labour Demand
cases.shortDescription: A logistics operator deploys automated picking systems across regional warehouses.
cases.longDescription: Illustrative case tracking employment composition, throughput and wage levels before and after automation at scale.
researchQuestions: Did automation raise output per worker without raising pay?

cases.title: Tariff Escalation and Input Costs
cases.shortDescription: A tariff cycle raises input costs for domestic manufacturers that depend on imported components.

cases.title: Disinflation Without a Deep Recession
cases.shortDescription: A central bank brings inflation down while unemployment rises only modestly.

cases.title: Industrial Policy for Battery Manufacturing
cases.shortDescription: Subsidies and local-content rules build a domestic battery industry.

cases.title: Border Formation After Imperial Dissolution
cases.shortDescription: Newly independent states inherit administratively convenient but socially arbitrary borders.

cases.title: Urbanisation and Class Formation in an Industrialising Region
cases.shortDescription: Rapid industrial growth draws rural workers into cities and reshapes social structure.

cases.title: Coastal Adaptation Under Rising Sea Levels
cases.shortDescription: A coastal municipality chooses between hard defences, managed retreat and hybrid approaches.

cases.title: Carbon Pricing with Revenue Recycling
cases.shortDescription: A jurisdiction pairs a carbon price with lump-sum dividends to households.

cases.title: Rapid Adaptation in a Fragmented Habitat
cases.shortDescription: A species adapts to a shrinking, fragmented habitat over a small number of generations.

cases.title: Microbiome Intervention and Metabolic Outcomes
cases.shortDescription: A dietary intervention alters microbial composition and correlates with metabolic change.

cases.title: Deployment of a General-Purpose Model in a Regulated Industry
cases.shortDescription: An organisation deploys a large model in a sector with strict liability rules.

cases.title: Place-Based Opportunity and Intergenerational Mobility
cases.shortDescription: Two neighbouring regions diverge sharply in mobility despite similar demographics.

cases.title: Stewardship Programme and Resistance Rates
cases.shortDescription: A hospital stewardship programme changes prescribing behaviour and resistance trends.

cases.title: The Explanatory Gap as a Research Programme
cases.shortDescription: Philosophers and scientists disagree on whether the explanatory gap is a permanent limit or a temporary one.
